lastMacIssueComment.body: The root README now documents the checkout installer for macOS, Linux and Windows. The optional Finder/Dock app in #501 is still in draft. When that app is ready to ship, add a short macOS launcher entry to the README that links to the verified instructions in the first-run guide. Use the actual installer command and distinguish opening the app in Finder from using its Dock pin. The existing Mac QA handoff owns those observations. [Installer-first README](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin#install-graphgoblin) · [Launcher delivery](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/501).

note: Read-only refresh. No new interactive Mac QA appears in issue discussion; PR501 remains draft. No source, index, account, or provider changes.
